ra.paediatric-elbow-fractures.population_note: Adult elbow reference only. The available mesh does not represent childhood ossification centres, open physes or age-dependent cartilaginous anatomy. Those structures still require a validated paediatric model.
ra.paediatric-elbow-fractures.reason: The shared paediatric hip/elbow module's default hip model is anatomically incorrect for an elbow-only investigation.

ra.mri-diabetic-foot.population_note: Adult right-foot reference only. The source includes pedal bones and selected neighbouring tissues; it does not provide every plantar-plate component, tendon sheath, postoperative variant or MRI infection finding. Complete reporting coverage and clinical fidelity review remain outstanding.
ra.mri-diabetic-foot.reason: The broad marrow/muscle lesson supplies a long-bone orientation model. This foot-only investigation instead needs the existing registered pedal anatomy, framed from all source foot bones.

ra.ultrasound-joint-injection.reason: The inherited IR access schematic depicts a generic vessel and target, not the named joint anatomy. Regional source meshes offer orientation only; each procedural target still requires validated anatomy.

ra.mri-hamstring.population_note: Adult right posterior-thigh muscle reference. Four native muscle surfaces are shown in full; attachment footprints, tendon volumes, fine aponeuroses and complete sciatic anatomy remain unverified. This is not patient MRI or an injury simulation.
ra.mri-hamstring.reason: The inherited long-bone schematic does not represent hamstring muscles. Frame the native posterior-thigh objects in full rather than using the knee crop.

ra.arthritis.reason: Arthritis reporting spans multiple joint groups; the inherited hand-only view cannot supply foot, knee or hip context.
